Site.title: Site
Site.description: An HTML project deployed by a user for instant public hosting

id.description: Unique identifier of the deployed HTML site

slug.description: Random domain slug for public access

title.description: Display title of the HTML page

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Google account who owns this HTML deploy

ownerEmail.description: Google email address of the owner

isPublished.description: Whether the HTML file is publicly accessible

fileSizeBytes.description: Size in bytes of the HTML content

version.description: Revision number that increments on each update

description.description: Optional short description or notes about the deploy

/sites/{siteId}.description: Stores user HTML deployments indexed by siteId or slug with strict owner access and instant public read if published
